title: LMPD Officer Shoots Armed Man After ShotSpotter Call
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Louisville, Kentucky — On December 18, 2025, at 11:17 a.m., LMPD officers in the first division were notified of a shot spotter alert indicating two rounds were fired in the air, followed by an additional eight rounds in the rear of 2327 West Chestnut Street. Officers arrived on scene about four minutes after being dispatched and found a man, later identified as 30-year-old Asa McNealy, in the alley who began to flee on foot. After a short foot pursuit, officers found McNealy in a backyard. The suspect was ordered by officers to not reach for anything and to put his hands in the air. McNealy told officers he had a gun and eventually reached for it in his waistband. One LMPD officer discharged his weapon, striking McNealy, who then fell to the ground. Officers continued to give verbal commands for McNealy to show his hands. Due to the lack of cover, officers were initially unable to approach McNealy to place him into custody and render aid. Eventually, officers used ballistic shields and approached the suspect. McNealy's handgun was removed from the immediate area and the suspect was placed in handcuffs and officers then began to render aid. McNealy was transported to UofL Hospital in downtown Louisville in critical condition, where he remains. McNealy was charged with wanton endangerment and possession of a handgun by a convicted felon.
